canonical_name: Magic Eden Bitcoin and Runes API
still_usable_note: Magic Eden states that its Bitcoin/Runes API and associated backend services were fully discontinued on 2026-03-27. This describes provider policy, not an independent test of every legacy endpoint.
summary: Magic Eden ended Bitcoin and Runes API/backend services effective March 27, 2026, while retaining its Solana API subject to ongoing review.
current_state: The official Magic Eden Help Center identifies the Bitcoin and Runes API shutdown as effective March 27, 2026. Solana API remains operational and is not included in this removed status; EVM developer integration support is handled separately.
replacement: No official substitute or migration tooling offered by Magic Eden
known_unknowns: The exact final operational state of every legacy API endpoint was not independently tested; primary documentation states the service is fully shut down.
notes: Magic Eden's 2026-06-30 retrospective Help Center notice uses March 27 as the deadline. Do not treat the Help Center publication date as the initial shutdown announcement date; and do not classify its Solana API as removed.
